svg.aria-label: Raj Acharya, Applied AI Engineer. I design and ship real-time voice agents, agentic systems and AI video pipelines. Focus: voice-agents: Phone and WebRTC agents: streaming STT, LLM tool calling, TTS, live call monitoring; agentic-systems: Multi-agent orchestration, MCP tool servers, RAG retrieval, tracing with Langfuse; ai-video: Automated pipelines from script and narration to a finished, rendered video.
